item.title: Punk Formal 12/5/25
item.description: IT'S THE LAST HOUSE SHOW OF THE SEMESTER AND YOU DON'T WANT TO MISS IT!!! Cancel all your plans, call off that date, forget about those overdue assignments because this Friday, December 5th, WUVT and WRKE are hosting Punk Formal with bands Dayfiction, Recluse and Jane Doe!!! Doors at 8pm, with music at 8:30 pm. at 436 East Roanoke. 5-dollar cover. See you there! Poster by Becca Reynolds

item.title: MILK PARLOR SHOW!!! 1/30/26
item.description: WUVT is hosting its first show of the semester at the Milk Parlor this Friday, January 30th with performances from Jirachi, Captain Caveman and the Paper Skulls. Doors at 8pm and music at 8:30pm, cover is 5 dollars. Attendance required.

item.title: First Vinyl Night of the Spring Semester!!! 1/29/26
item.description: WUVT has personally shoveled, plowed, salted and cleared every single road in Blacksburg to make sure YOU can get to the first Vinyl Night of the semester at Rising Silo this Thursday 1/29 from 6-9pm! Enjoy food and drinks while listening to your favorite WUVT DJs spin Americana and Folk themed vinyl live. All are welcome!

item.title: WUVT OPEN HOUSE 1/30/26
item.description: WUVT wants to invite you to our spring open house this Friday from 6-9pm! Learn about hosting your own show live on-air and win prizes. Come to Squires room 350 for this awesome opportunity!
